title: Naturality of diagonal inverse-image sections
statement: Let F be a sheaf of sets on the small etale site of a scheme X. For each etale U over X define d_F,U(s) by applying the inverse-image adjunction unit along U.hom to s in F(U), then restricting along the diagonal U to U times_X U. For g:V to U in X_et, d_F,V(F(g)(s)) equals the inverse-image unit along g.left applied to d_F,U(s), transported back by the inverse of terminal section transport for the triangle V to U to X. This equality uses exactly the inverse-image adjunctions and terminal transport of [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units] and [def-weil-pbc-sets-terminal-transport].

source.place: Tag 0GLZ, diagonal unit and sectionwise transpose argument; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0GLZ (read online; local source absent)

proof.text: Use naturality of the inverse-image unit at the diagonal and naturality of the composition isomorphism to move the two diagonal restrictions past these maps.

Apply the composition-unit equality. The remaining pullback morphisms have equal projections, so pullback uniqueness identifies them. Naturality of the composite inverse-image unit then proves the asserted equality.

lean.statement:
theorem proEtaleComparisonDiagonalSection_naturality {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (U V : X.Etale) (g : V ⟶ U) (s : F.obj.obj (op U)) :
    δ[X, F, V] (F.obj.map g.op s) =
      (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
        (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ g.left) (Type (u + 1))
        (U.left.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
        (V.left.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app
          ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback U.hom).obj F)).hom.app
            (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 U.left))) ≫
        (etaleSetTerminalTransport U.hom g.left V.hom g.w F).inv)
          (δ[X, F, U] s)
